description: Patch generated by the WYSIWYG JS engine and applied by Blazor.

members.name: AfterSelection
members.description: Expected selection snapshot after the browser/input transaction changed the DOM.

members.name: BeforeSelection
members.description: Selection snapshot before the browser/input transaction changed the DOM.

members.name: Block
members.description: Block data payload for InsertBlock or UpdateBlock patches.

members.name: BlockType
members.description: Block type for InsertBlock patches (e.g. Paragraph, Heading, Image).

members.name: Data
members.description: Input data (e.g. inserted text).

members.name: DeleteLength
members.description: Number of characters to delete for DeleteRange patches.

members.name: HasImage
members.description: Whether the clipboard contained an image.

members.name: HeadingLevel
members.description: Heading level when BlockType is Heading.

members.name: Html
members.description: Pasted HTML content.

members.name: Inline
members.description: Inline content payload for InsertInline patches.

members.name: LinkTitle
members.description: Optional hyperlink title for link mark patches.

members.name: MarkType
members.description: Mark type for SetMarks patches (e.g. Bold, Italic, Underline).

members.name: OperationId
members.description: Stable JS runtime operation identifier for persistence, collaboration, and undo metadata.

members.name: ParagraphProperties
members.description: Partial paragraph formatting payload for SetParagraphProperties patches.

members.name: Plain
members.description: Pasted plain text content.

members.name: ProtocolVersion
members.description: Protocol version of the patch.

members.name: RevisionId
members.description: Stable revision identifier for track-changes patches generated by the JS engine.

members.name: RevisionType
members.description: Revision type for track-changes patches (Insertion or Deletion).

members.name: Selection
members.description: Selection snapshot at the time of the patch.

members.name: TransactionId
members.description: Transaction id for undo batching.

members.name: Type
members.description: Patch type: InsertText, InsertInline, DeleteRange, SetMarks, SetParagraphProperties, InsertBlock, SplitBlock, InsertSoftBreak, UpdateBlock, RemoveBlock, Paste.
